veranderings.voor: Die Aarde beweeg altyd in dieselfde rigting op hierdie pad.
veranderings.na: Op hierdie pad beweeg die Aarde altyd in dieselfde rigting.
veranderings.rede: Fronting 'op hierdie pad' links the sentence to the previous one and avoids three consecutive sentences opening with 'Die Aarde'.

veranderings.voor: Die Aarde beweeg nooit terug nie
veranderings.rede: The repeated subject 'Die Aarde beweeg' in back-to-back sentences reads wooden; the pronoun 'dit' is already used for the Earth earlier in this block.
